report_type: REAL_TIME evaluation of the registered ensemble candidates, v2 (corrected protocol actuals D-147, corrected T2 mixture docs/94, all four candidates)

supersedes.reason: v1 actuals were raw series levels, not the protocol targets (D-147); every relative loss and C1/C2/C5 status in the v1 reports is invalid. The files are kept as history.

corrected_actuals.rule: protocol targets from the first publication, not the raw series level (T1 yoy, T2 annualised growth); first publication = first archived vintage containing the period, target recomputed from that same vintage
corrected_actuals.old_report_invalid: protocols/ensemble_evaluation_report.json (v1) used raw series levels as actuals and is marked INVALID in docs/87

evaluation_mode.forecasts: point-in-time forecasts from the dense quarterly ALFRED vintage archive (amfe.forecast); no future data enters a forecast
evaluation_mode.actuals: protocol targets from the first publication: the first archived vintage containing the period and the target recomputed from that same vintage (T1 yyy; T2 annualised growth), D-147
evaluation_mode.secondary_actuals: target from the vintage available 12 months after the reference period
evaluation_mode.comparator: frozen composition + protocol mixture of member CDFs (unweighted, tails per docs/72); T2 CRPS only with the corrected mixture (docs/94)
evaluation_mode.real_time_rule: origins with month >= 1996-12 only (ALFRED GS10/TB3MS vintages start 1996-12-03); the runner's REAL_TIME guard would skip earlier origins

cross_cutting.reporting_only: This report records the harness statuses computed from the frozen criteria; it does not assign admission (CANDIDATE / SHADOW_TEST / LIMITED_DEPLOYMENT).

C6.reason: the forward registry has no resolved forecasts; the maximum possible stage in the first days of the registry is CANDIDATE

C4.T1_W1: INCONCLUSIVE (8 recession origins < protocol minimum 12): C4 can never pass on W1 with the current REAL_TIME data availability; this is a data-depth limitation
C4.T1_W2: per candidate/loss statuses are in the candidate tables
C4.T2: reported per candidate if T2 h=0 was evaluated; the runner now uses the origin month for the h=0 recession mask (previously degenerate)
C4.rule: C4 never counts as passed unless every window/loss passes; INCONCLUSIVE is not a pass

SPF.role: T2 h=0 candidate ensembles may include the SPF median at SPF-deadline origins (middle month of the quarter); the SPF is NOT a member of the frozen comparator, so the T2 comparison is not apples-to-apples unless a sensitivity without SPF is reported (track U, docs/95)
SPF.mapping: official SPF mapping confirmed in docs/86: drgdp2=survey quarter, drgdp3..6 = +1..+4; protocol T2 h -> drgdp(h+2)
SPF.values_policy: SPF values stay in git-ignored data/raw/spf; only derived statistics are reported, with attribution to the Philadelphia Fed

limitations: v1 report/summary are INVALID (raw-level actuals, D-147) and are not used; they remain in the repository as history only
C4 W1 INCONCLUSIVE (8 recession origins < 12) blocks the CANDIDATE -> SHADOW_TEST stage regardless of the candidate's losses
C6 has no resolved forecasts; C3 is not implemented (non-gating)
the first ~12 origins of W1 use calibration history where models needing the yield-curve inputs (BVAR) can be PSEUDO_REAL_TIME because GS10/TB3MS vintages start 1996-12
T1/T2 candidates use the same members as the comparator (plus SPF only at T2 survey-deadline origins); the SPF inclusion requires the separate sensitivity (docs/95)
runtimes are dominated by dense-vintage DataContext construction per member/origin

the official v2 pass now covers all four registered candidates: INVERSE_MSE/BAYES evidence comes from the extended pass (protocols/extended_pass/), and the multiplicity table is recomputed jointly over the family of 4 (the per-candidate files retain their own family-1/2 adjusted p-values as raw evidence and are superseded only for the official multiplicity table)

candidate_coverage.note: all four registered ensemble candidates are evaluated on T1 h=1 and T2 h=0

extended_pass.purpose: INVERSE_MSE and BAYES were scored after the reduced first pass; the merged official report recomputes one Romano-Wolf family over all four candidates

ENSEMBLE_EQUAL.note: the evidence file is the per-candidate artefact from the extended/reduced pass; the official multiplicity table is recomputed in the joint family of 4, so the adjusted p-values in the evidence file are superseded. Statuses and RMSE match exactly; CRPS can differ by <=1e-3 relative because the weighted-mixture robust path (commit 571891d) landed after the evidence files were produced -- the official CRPS is the joint run on the current code
